UtherHolyLightSilverTouch.name: Silver Touch
UtherHolyLightSilverTouch.description: Quest: Reduce damage from Heroic sources with Devotion. Reward: After reducing damage 40 times, Holy Light's Mana cost is reduced from 80 to 60. Reward: After reducing damage 80 times, Holy Light's Mana cost is reduced to 40, and its range is increased by 50%.

UtherMasteryWaveofLightHolyRadiance.name: Wave of Light
UtherMasteryWaveofLightHolyRadiance.description: Quest: Damage or heal Heroes 60 times with Holy Radiance. Reward: Increase the duration of Devotion by 0.5 seconds. Passive: Damaging or healing Heroes with Holy Radiance refunds 5 Mana and reduces its cooldown by 0.75 seconds.

UtherCombatStyleHammerOfTheLightbringer.name: Hammer of the Lightbringer
UtherCombatStyleHammerOfTheLightbringer.description: Quest: Basic Attack enemies 75 times. Reward: Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Hammer of Justice by 1.5 seconds. Passive: Basic Attacks restore 1.5% of Uther's maximum Mana.

UtherMasteryHolyShock.name: Holy Shock
UtherMasteryHolyShock.description: Holy Light can be used on an enemy to do 40% of its healing amount as damage. When used this way, Uther receives its self-healing benefits, its cooldown is reduced by 6 seconds, and it refunds 45 Mana.

UtherHammerOfJusticePursuitOfJustice.name: Pursuit of Justice
UtherHammerOfJusticePursuitOfJustice.description: Hammer of Justice increases Uther's Movement Speed by 25% for 3 seconds.

UtherHolyFire.name: Holy Fire
UtherHolyFire.description: Deal 13 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies. Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes increase this damage by 20% for 3 seconds. This can stack up to 3 times.

UtherEternalDevotionArmorOfFaith.name: Armor of Faith
UtherEternalDevotionArmorOfFaith.description: Being Stunned, Rooted, or Silenced grants Uther 90 Mana and causes Holy Light's cooldown to recharge 200% faster for 6 seconds. This effect has a 20 second cooldown.

UtherEternalDevotionGuardianOfAncientKin.name: Guardian of Ancient Kings
UtherEternalDevotionGuardianOfAncientKin.description: Healing a Hero with a Basic Ability that is Stunned, Rooted, or Silenced grants them 50 Armor for 3 seconds.

UtherHandOfProtection.name: Hand of Protection
UtherHandOfProtection.description: Activate to make target ally Unstoppable for 1 second. Cannot be cast on Uther. Basic Attacks reduce Hand of Protection's cooldown by 5 seconds.

UtherHeroicAbilityDivineShield.name: Divine Shield
UtherHeroicAbilityDivineShield.description: Make an allied Hero Invulnerable and increase their Movement Speed by 20% for 3 seconds.

UtherHeroicAbilityDivineStorm.name: Divine Storm
UtherHeroicAbilityDivineStorm.description: Deal 170 (+4% per level) damage and Stun nearby enemies for 1.75 seconds.

UtherMasteryBlessedChampion.name: Blessed Champion
UtherMasteryBlessedChampion.description: For the next 5 seconds after using Holy Light, Uther's Basic Attacks heal him and nearby allied Heroes for 15% of the total amount healed by Holy Light.

UtherHammerOfJusticeWellMet.name: Well Met
UtherHammerOfJusticeWellMet.description: When used against Heroes, Hammer of Justice reduces the target's Movement Speed and damage dealt by 25% for 3 seconds.

GenericTalentSpellShield.name: Spell Shield
GenericTalentSpellShield.description: Every 30 seconds, gain 50 Spell Armor against the next enemy Ability and subsequent Abilities for 3 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 50%. Can be toggled to allow or prevent this talent from triggering automatically.

UtherBeaconOfLight.name: Beacon of Light
UtherBeaconOfLight.description: Uther receives 125% bonus self-healing when targeting others with Holy Light. This bonus is increased to 250% while he is below 50% Health.

UtherHolyRadianceTyrsDeliverance.name: Tyr's Deliverance
UtherHolyRadianceTyrsDeliverance.description: Increase the damage and healing of Holy Radiance by 10%. Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes cause Uther's next cast of Holy Radiance to have its damage and healing increased by an additional 10%, stacking up to 7 times.

UtherMasteryBenediction.name: Benediction
UtherMasteryBenediction.description: Activate to reduce the Mana cost of Uther's next Basic Ability by 50 and its cooldown by 10 seconds.

UtherMasteryBulwarkOfLightDivineShield.name: Bulwark of Light
UtherMasteryBulwarkOfLightDivineShield.description: Divine Shield is also applied to all nearby allied Heroes and lasts 1 second longer.

UtherMasteryDivineHurricaneDivineStorm.name: Divine Hurricane
UtherMasteryDivineHurricaneDivineStorm.description: Divine Storm's radius is increased by 50% and its cooldown is reduced by 40 seconds.

UtherMasteryRedemption.name: Redemption
UtherMasteryRedemption.description: After Eternal Vanguard ends, Uther revives at the spirit's location with 50% of his maximum Health. This effect has a 180 second cooldown.

UtherEternalDevotionDivineProtection.name: Divine Protection
UtherEternalDevotionDivineProtection.description: Increase Devotion Armor to 50 and its duration by 0.5 seconds.
